Surya Namaskar, or Sun Salutation, is a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas [PROG_Y_001]. It is best done early morning on an empty stomach, and each posture is coordinated with your breath [PROG_Y_001]. 

Ek complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left [PROG_Y_001]. Regular practice provides a great cardiovascular workout, improves blood circulation, helps with weight loss (वजन घटाना), strengthens muscles and joints, improves digestion, and reduces stress (tanav) [PROG_Y_001]. People with high blood pressure, hernia, or back problems should consult a doctor or certified instructor before performing it [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom ek powerful pranayama hai jo mind ko calm karne aur stress relieve karne mein madad karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Yeh body ke Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karne mein help karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Iske alawa, yeh patience aur concentration ko bhi improve karta hai [PROG_P_001].

Ek healthy lifestyle ke liye balanced diet zaroori hai [PROG_D_001]. Breakfast mein fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli le sakte hain [PROG_D_001]. Lunch mein 2 rotis, ek bowl dal, sabzi, aur salad shamil karein [PROG_D_001]. Dinner sabse halka hona chahiye, jiske liye khichdi ya dal ke sath vegetable stir-fry ek accha option hai [PROG_D_001]. 

Din bhar mein kam se kam 8-10 glasses paani (water) piyein aur processed sugar serta excessive salt se bachein [PROG_D_001]. Cravings ko manage karne ke liye nuts and seeds khana ek acha tarika hai [PROG_D_001].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that involves active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. Sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath in, and exhale in short, powerful bursts while your stomach pumps inwards [PROG_P_002]. 

Start with 20-30 pumps per round and do up to 3 rounds with breaks [PROG_P_002]. It stimulates digestion, improves metabolic rate, and aids in weight loss [PROG_P_002]. Perform it on an empty stomach, ideally in the morning [PROG_P_002]. 

Avoid Kapalbhati if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana (Triangle Pose) is a foundational standing pose that stretches the entire body [PROG_Y_003]. To do it, stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in slightly [PROG_Y_003]. Inhale, and as you exhale, extend your torso to the right, bending from the hips and placing your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor, while extending your left arm up to the sky [PROG_Y_003]. 

This pose stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine, while strengthening the legs and core [PROG_Y_003]. It is therapeutic for stress and improves digestion by stimulating the abdominal organs [PROG_Y_003]. Avoid it if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury, and dont lock your knees [PROG_Y_003]. Hold for 30-60 seconds [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) bahut accha hai. Isme tongue ko tube shape me roll karke mouth se bahar nikalte hain aur slow and deep inhale karte hain jaise straw se air sip kar rahe hon [PROG_P_004]. Fir tongue andar karke mouth close karte hain aur nostrils se slow exhale karte hain [PROG_P_004]. Isse body cool hoti hai aur hunger and thirst control karne me help milti hai [PROG_P_004]. Isko 5-10 times repeat kar sakte hain [PROG_P_004]. Low blood pressure ya respiratory issues jaise asthma wale ise na karein [PROG_P_004].

Immunity badhane ke liye ek balanced diet zaroori hai [PROG_D_002]. Apni diet mein citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons shamil karein kyunki yeh Vitamin C se rich hote hain [PROG_D_002]. Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai, ise milk ya curries mein add karein [PROG_D_002]. Ginger aur garlic bhi medicinal properties ke liye acche hain [PROG_D_002]. Yogurt gut health ke liye probiotics ka great source hai [PROG_D_002]. Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) antioxidants se packed hain [PROG_D_002], aur almonds Vitamin E ka great source hain [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience, having started his journey in Rishikesh under traditional yoga gurus [PROG_I_001]. His teaching style blends classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment, breath, pranayama, and meditation [PROG_I_001]. He specializes in therapeutic yoga to help manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains that are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants [PROG_D_004]. They are considered a modern superfood for a healthy lifestyle rather than just gaon ka khana [PROG_D_004]. Ragi (Finger Millet) provides calcium for bones, Jowar (Sorghum) offers iron and protein, and Bajra (Pearl Millet) supplies magnesium for heart health [PROG_D_004]. With their high fiber and low glycemic index, they aid in weight management and suit diabetics [PROG_D_004].

You can practice Shavasana (Corpse Pose) to relax deeply. Lie flat on your back with feet apart and arms by your sides, palms facing up. Close your eyes, let go of breath control, and release tension (*thakaan*). Spend 5-10 minutes staying aware and relaxed without falling asleep [PROG_Y_004]. 

Another option is Balasana (Childs Pose). Kneel on the floor, sit back on your heels, fold forward to rest your forehead on the floor, and hold for 30 seconds to a few minutes with deep breathing to calm your brain and relieve stress [PROG_Y_005].

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Masters degree in Food and Nutrition [PROG_I_002]. She follows a no-deprivation approach and creates sustainable diet plans that fit your lifestyle and cultural eating habits [PROG_I_002]. You can book a one-on-one consultation with her to create a khaane ka plan (eating plan) [PROG_I_002]. She is available on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Paani peene ke fayde ye hain ki staying hydrated overall health ke liye crucial hai [PROG_D_003]. Water body temperature regulate karta hai, joints ko lubricate karta hai, aur cells tak nutrients deliver karne mein help karta hai [PROG_D_003]. Dehydration se headaches, fatigue, aur poor concentration ho sakte hain [PROG_D_003]. 

Aapko day mein 8-10 glasses of water aim karna chahiye, aur exercise ya hot day mein aur zyada [PROG_D_003]. Meals ke pehle water peene se weight management mein aid milta hai kyunki aapko full feel hota hai [PROG_D_003]. Ye kidney function aur toxins flush out karne ke liye essential hai [PROG_D_003]. Better taste ke liye aap lemon, cucumber, ya mint leaves infuse kar sakte hain [PROG_D_003].
